<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex034042026-11-1311-12-03" status="reviewed"> 
            <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (29a1-29a3)"/>
            <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4704"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">mang du thos pa'i slob dpon shag kya 'od</rs> kyis mdzad pa <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3764">gzhi' <expan>thams cad</expan> yod par smra ba'i dge tshul rnams kyi tshig le'ur byas pa</rs>'i rnam par bshad pa</rs> | dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mtshan nas brjod par dka' ba'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3818">shag kya'i dge' slong brtson 'grus 'bar</rs> dang | smra ba'i seng ge grags pas <lb edRef="inst:4703" n="29a3"/> kun la khyab pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3946">shag kya'i dge slong gzhon nu seng ge</rs>'i zhabs la spyi bos gtugs pa'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3969">shag kya'i dge slong chos kyi dbang phyug</rs> gis sbyar ba || × rdzogs s+ho || × || × || ×||</seg></TEI>
